name: best_vary_sel_sigma
description: Single-axis: selection-kernel width (focus vs spread of the curated points). Anchored at the 10-seed joint-search sweet spot (deeper undertrained regime + wide kernel, warm-start): n_bumps 5, noise_std 0.05, radius 0.25, iters_initial 12, n_train 100, sel_sigma 0.5, n_select 100, mix_ratio 0.5, iters_retrain 400, Weakpoint distance. At this anchor guided beats the random baseline over the WHOLE area ~75-85% of the time (gap ~-0.25) and fixes the weakspot hard. Default detector trio = strong, diverse detectors here (Quantile Regression, Peaks over Threshold (EVT), RBF Interpolation); 20 seeds. Sweeps sel_sigma [0.05..5.0]: narrow = tightly focused on the weakspot (strong in-gap fix, more global distortion), wide = spread toward coverage. Extended to 5.0 to capture the interior optimum and the graceful convergence back to the random baseline as the Gaussian kernel flattens to uniform (exp(-d^2/2sigma^2) -> const, so guided selection -> uniform -> gap -> 0).
